nonIndexablePagesDetail: Pages that exist in dist but are deliberately absent from site-urls.txt and the sitemap: 22 x 404 (root + 21 non-English locales) + 1 Netlify forms placeholder (/__forms). Invariant checked in verify-baseline: htmlTotal - site-urls.txt lines === this number. Update it deliberately, with a reason, when the set changes (e.g. English-only posts add 21 fallback shims each, which do stay out of the list).
updateReason: Four English-only regulatory posts (fda-510k-vs-eu-mdr-ipl, iec-62471-photobiological-safety-ipl, ipl-device-emc-testing, ipl-labeling-and-claims). Values are read from verify-baseline's own output, not multiplied by hand: htmlTotal 3433 -> 3521 (4 x 22 = 88), blogPerLocale 77 -> 81 in all 22 locales because the i18n fallback rewrite puts the English text in every locale directory, and nonIndexablePages 23 -> 107 because each of the four posts adds 21 fallback pages whose canonical points at the English original, so they stay out of site-urls.txt and the sitemap.
